Subject: Permaily: the model's canary saw an answer move

The daily canary saw an answer of the model move from what was measured for the prompt version in force, or another model answer.

    Day (UTC): 2026-11-16

The service goes on, and answers already kept do not change. Run the eval on the whole corpus: if the thresholds still hold, a release takes the new answers as the canary's; if not, a release with a new prompt version, or without the model, follows.

This message is sent by the enclave. It holds no amount tied to an account and nothing of anyone's mail.
